title: LG LSC27926 SxS — Main PCB test modes
description: Main PCB test button: ×1 all loads (Test 1), ×2 forced defrost (Test 2).

steps.title: Test Mode 1 — strong cold
steps.body: Push main PCB test button once: compressor, F-FAN, C-FAN run; defrost heater OFF; main damper OPEN; all display segments ON.
steps.sourceExcerpt: Push main PCB test button once: compressor, F-FAN, C-FAN run; defrost heater OFF; main damper OPEN; all display segments ON.

steps.title: Test Mode 2 — forced defrost
steps.body: From Test 1, push test button once: compressor/fans OFF; defrost heater ON; damper CLOSED; display segments OFF.
steps.sourceExcerpt: From Test 1, push test button once: compressor/fans OFF; defrost heater ON; damper CLOSED; display segments OFF.
